name: Aya
source:
A married woman in her 30s who is an old friend of Yuka. Has a slender body, but has put on some weight on some places. 

She prioritizes her charm first, so she's a bit bewitching yet mischievous. A broad-minded woman who is not discriminating to anyone. 

[Translated from [url=http://herencia.nexton-net.jp/product/relaxation_yuka_en/index.html#character]Official Site[/url]]
